markets.name: Cocoa
markets.cot_note: COT blends CFTC NY Cocoa (60%) + ICE London Cocoa (40%) via z-score normalization. Raw blending is invalid: London is GBP-denominated with ~100k OI vs NY ~200k, and London has higher commercial concentration (65-73% of OI vs NY 48-50%). Each exchange's signals are normalized within their own history before blending, making them comparable on a unit-free basis. London adds the European physical demand signal (cash buyers, grinding industry); NY captures the financial/macro speculative overlay.
